summary: Routine dependency bumps: Python packages (cryptography, nats-py 2.15->2.16, packaging, psycopg, tldextract, uvicorn, Markdown), NATS server 2.14.4->2.15.0 (settings NATS_SERVER_VER + tactical-nats Docker image), MeshCentral 1.2.4->1.2.5, and the Nushell version installed on agents 0.112.2->0.115.1.

statements.why: Patch/minor version bumps; no code or permission changes.
True, but doesn't say it upgrades the NATS server image 2.14.4 -> 2.15.0.
True but doesn't say it bumps NATS server, MeshCentral and the Nushell version pushed to agents.

statements.text: 1. Test anything that uses cryptography: 50.0.0 to 50.0.1.
2. Test anything that uses nats-py: 2.15.0 to 2.16.0.
statements.why: requirements.txt:17; nats is the server-agent messaging channel, so this is the important one.

statements.text: 3. Test anything that uses packaging: 25.0 to 26.3.
4. Test anything that uses psycopg: 3.3.4 to 3.3.5.
5. Test anything that uses tldextract: 5.3.1 to 5.3.2.
6. Test anything that uses uvicorn: 0.52.1 to 0.53.0.
7. Test anything that uses markdown: 3.10.2 to 3.10.3.

misses.what: NATS server (the message bus between the server and every agent) is upgraded 2.14.4->2.15.0 in settings and the tactical-nats Docker image; the card lists the dockerfile but neither says this nor puts it in the test steps.
Agents will install Nushell 0.115.1 (was 0.112.2) and MeshCentral version moves to 1.2.5; scripts relying on Nushell behaviour should be checked.
